बाण कवि
 Śabdacandrikā lex. Burnell 49^a. He quotes
Mādhavācārya.

बाण भट्ट son of Citrabhānu, son of Arthapati, son of
Kubera, father of Bhūṣaṇa Bhaṭṭa:
 Kādambarī.
 Caṇḍīśataka.
 Pārvatīpariṇaya rūpaka.
 Mukuṭatāḍitaka nāṭaka. Quoted by Caṇḍapāla
on Damayantīkāvya p. 227.
 Sarvacaritanāṭaka. Rādh 23.
 Harṣacarita.
 Verses of his are given in the Aucityavicāra-
carcā 14. 20. etc. Śp. p. 50. Skm. Sbhv.

बाणस्तव or रामबाणस्तव by Rāmabhadra, son of Yajña-
rāma.

बाणासुरविजय campū, in 6 Ullāsa, by Veṅkaṭa of Sura-
pura, son of Śrīnivāsa, and pupil of Varadācārya.
Śg. 1, 43 p. 77.

बाणेश्वर son of Jaṭādhara, father of Nārāyaṇa (Prākṛta-
pāda, etc.).

बाणेश्वर one of the authors of the Vivādārṇavasetu.
Sūcīpattra 34.

बाणेश्वर son of Rāmadeva, grandson of Viṣṇu, composed
in 1744:
 Citracampū.
बाणविजय kāvya by Śivarāma Cakravartin. AS p. 171.
